what: The About sentence is split into several chunks, and once on screen one chunk lights up every 2.4s. The lit chunk goes from a faded color to its own color (.3s ease-out), and the chip word inside changes to accent-color text on a light accent background (.5s). The cards below light up (is-on) in the same order, and hovering a card jumps to that chunk and pauses while the pointer stays.

options.each: Length one segment stays on (seconds), default 2.4 — also the length of one loop of the image in the card
options.[data-fx-part=phrase]: Sentence fragments to toggle on and off (children, two or more)
options.[data-fx-part=mark]: Chip word inside the block (optional) — accent color when on
options.[data-fx-part=pick]: Card matching the segment’s order (optional) — is-on when lit, hovering selects that segment
options.--fx-dim · --fx-on · --fx-dur: Off color · on color · color change duration (style), default --kf-dim · --kf-ink · .3s
options.fx:pick event: Reports detail.index from the element when the segment changes — for replaying art inside cards
